text: Good evening. Please I have been on the line waiting for over forty minutes and nobody has picked, so I am trying this message instead. I am the grandfather of a girl of 4 years, her mother left her with me for the weekend. I just want to know the correct quantity of paracetamol or ibuprofen to give her, I think the bottle in the house is the children's one but I am not too sure which strength, the label has faded small. I don't want to give her too much or too little, you understand. Before anybody panics, let me say it now: her lips are blue, yes, but it is because she has just finished a blue ice lolly her grandmother bought, the tongue is blue too, everything is blue, I wiped some of it off with tissue and it is coming off. She is breathing fine, normal, no wahala at all with that. Please just tell me the dose for her age and how many hours to wait between. I have been patient o but this waiting is too much.
